logline: Rupert and Catherine frame Juliana for poisoning the Duchess despite the bedridden matriarch's protests, uncovering Juliana's true noble identity and her mother's herbarium before ordering her to the castle dungeons.
continuity_notes: Picks up directly from Episode 27 as Rupert orders the guard to seize Juliana, ignoring the waking Duchess.

blocks.text: Medium shot as the guard drags Juliana toward the doorway, wrestling her backward.
Juliana struggles against the guard's grip; the leather-bound herbarium slips from her apron pocket and falls to the stone floor.
Heavy thud of the leather journal hitting the polished floor.
Low-angle close-up of the leather-bound herbarium on the floor as Catherine's silk slipper steps down hard upon its embossed cover.
Catherine plants her embroidered shoe deliberately atop the fallen book.
Medium two-shot tracking Catherine as she strides gracefully across the chamber toward Juliana, Rupert standing stoically behind her near the bed.

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE
blocks.text: "Look at her, Rupert."

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE
blocks.text: "Soot on her face..."
Over-the-shoulder shot from behind Catherine as she faces Juliana, who is pinned in the doorway by the guard.

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE
blocks.text: "...herbs in her pockets..."

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE
blocks.text: "...a secret medicine in her hand."
Tight close-up of Catherine's smiling face, her eyes gleaming with vindictive pleasure.

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE
blocks.text: "She looks exactly like a poisoner."
Close-up of Juliana glaring back in fierce indignation, breathing heavily as she resists the guard's arm across her shoulder.

blocks.speaker: JULIANA
blocks.text: "I did not poison her! Look at her eyes, the fever has broken!"
Medium full shot of Rupert standing beside the four-poster bed, calmly pulling on his black leather gloves.

blocks.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
blocks.text: "A clever story, girl."

blocks.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
blocks.text: "But the guards know how to extract the truth."
Medium close-up of the Dowager Duchess stirring against her pillows, lifting her trembling head with visible effort.

blocks.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
blocks.text: "Rupert..."
Medium shot of Rupert pausing mid-stride as he hears his mother's voice, slowly turning his head toward the bed.

blocks.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
blocks.text: "Stop this!"
Wide shot of the bedchamber framed through the bed curtains as the Duchess props herself up on one elbow and points an accusing finger.

blocks.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
blocks.text: "She is innocent."

blocks.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
blocks.text: "She saved me!"
Close-up of Juliana, tears of relief welling in her eyes.

blocks.speaker: JULIANA
blocks.text: "Your Grace..."
Close-up of the Duchess clutching at her nightgown, her face twisted in mounting fury and horror.

blocks.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
blocks.text: "I know what happened to me!"
Medium low-angle shot past the Duchess pointing directly at Rupert, who stands rigid and expressionless.

blocks.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
blocks.text: "I was poisoned!"

blocks.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
blocks.text: "And you... you knew!"
Medium shot of the Duchess lunging forward from the pillows, gasping for breath as she points toward Catherine.

blocks.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
blocks.text: "Catherine knew!"

blocks.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
blocks.text: "They have been—"
The Duchess collapses back onto the pillows, coughing violently and clutching her chest.
Wide shot as Juliana lunges across the room toward the bed, but the armed guard seizes her from behind and drags her back.

blocks.speaker: JULIANA
blocks.text: "Let me help her!"

blocks.speaker: JULIANA
blocks.text: "She's still weak, you cannot leave her like this!"
Medium close-up of Rupert smoothing down his black leather gloves, a chilling smile forming on his lips.

blocks.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
blocks.text: "You see?"

blocks.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
blocks.text: "The poison has clearly damaged her mind."
Over-the-shoulder shot of Rupert leaning menacingly over the gasping Duchess in bed.

blocks.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
blocks.text: "I am not delusional!"

blocks.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
blocks.text: "Of course you are not."

blocks.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
blocks.text: "You are merely confused."
Medium profile tracking shot of Catherine walking deliberately toward Juliana, speaking with airy cynicism.

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE
blocks.text: "How convenient that the only person who can prove the poison exists..."

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE
blocks.text: "...is the maid who claims to have discovered it."
Low-angle medium shot of Rupert turning sharply toward the guard, his eyes icy and authoritative.

blocks.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
blocks.text: "Take her away before she poisons the rest of this house."
Tight close-up of Catherine's gloved hands grabbing the delicate chain around Juliana's neck.
Catherine ruthlessly yanks the silver locket off Juliana's neck.

blocks.speaker: JULIANA
blocks.text: "No!"
Medium close-up of Catherine holding up the oval silver and amethyst pendant, inspecting it with disdain.

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE
blocks.text: "Where did a gutter rat like you find a silver locket?"
Close-up of Juliana crying out in agony, writhing in the guard's iron grip.

blocks.speaker: JULIANA
blocks.text: "Give it back!"

blocks.speaker: JULIANA
blocks.text: "It belonged to my mother!"
Low-angle shot tracking the silver locket as Catherine casually flings it across the stone corridor floor.

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE
blocks.text: "A witch has no need for family heirlooms in the gallows."
Metallic clatter as the silver pendant bounces against the wooden baseboard.
Medium shot of Juliana being dragged further into the doorway, staring helplessly toward her discarded locket.

blocks.speaker: JULIANA
blocks.text: "My mother's locket!"
Medium shot of Catherine walking toward the fallen leather-bound book and kneeling gracefully to pick it up.
Catherine lifts the heavy herbarium, dusting off the cover before opening its aged parchment pages.
Tight close-up of Catherine reading the elegant cursive script inside the front cover.

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE
blocks.text: "Juliana..."
Extreme close-up on the handwritten inscription: 'Juliana Ashcroft'.
Medium shot of Juliana freezing in the doorway as she sees Catherine opening her mother's book.
Juliana gasps in horror, realizing her secret identity has been laid bare.
Close-up of Catherine raising her gaze slowly from the book, a wicked, triumphant grin spreading across her face.

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE
blocks.text: "Lady Juliana Ashcroft."
Medium two-shot as Catherine steps deliberately up to Juliana, circling her like a predator savoring its prey.

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE
blocks.text: "I knew I had seen those eyes before."

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE
blocks.text: "The disgraced daughter..."

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE
blocks.text: "...the girl thrown out of her own family home."
Close-up two-shot of Catherine leaning inches from Juliana's face, whispering her humiliating past.

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE
blocks.text: "The bride who married a penniless war veteran..."

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE
blocks.text: "...because no respectable man would have her."
Tight close-up of Juliana's eyes blazing with explosive fury and defensive loyalty.

blocks.speaker: JULIANA
blocks.text: "Do not speak about my husband!"
Medium two-shot as Catherine throws her head back in derisive laughter, brandishing the herbarium book.

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE
blocks.text: "And look at you now. Scrubbing fireplaces in my house."

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE
blocks.text: "What a magnificent fall, Lady Juliana."
Medium shot of Rupert gesturing toward the exit with an outstretched arm.

blocks.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
blocks.text: "Drag her to the wet cells beneath the south tower."
Close-up of Catherine fanning open the illustrated botanical pages of the herbarium with gloved fingers.

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE
blocks.text: "And this?"

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE
blocks.text: "This book of weeds will hang her before the magistrate."
Medium shot of Juliana thrashing frantically against the guard's grip, her arm reaching out toward the book.

blocks.speaker: JULIANA
blocks.text: "That book is my mother's life's work!"
Medium close-up of Catherine smiling coldly, clutching the closed book against her bodice.

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE
blocks.text: "Then perhaps you can explain every page to the magistrate..."

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE
blocks.text: "...before he sends you to the gallows."
Extreme close-up of Juliana's wide, trembling eyes as the guard wrenches her backward into the dark hallway, cutting sharply to black.
